Bill.BriefDescription: Granting authority of a watershed management partnership to exercise powers of its forming governments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authority of a watershed managementpartnership to exercise powers of its forming governments; and addinga new section to chapter 39.34 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.34 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) As limited by subsections (2) and (3) of this section, awatershed management partnership formed under the authority of RCW39.34.210, and a separate legal entity established by such apartnership to conduct the cooperative undertaking of the partnershipunder the same statutory authority, may exercise the power of eminentdomain as provided in chapter 8.12 RCW. (2) The eminent domain authority granted under subsection (1) ofthis section may be exercised only for those utility purposes for whichthe watershed management partnership was formed. (3) Subsection (1) of this section applies only to a watershedmanagement partnership that: (a) Was formed before July 1, 2006, under the authority of RCW39.34.210; p. 1 SHB 1561 (b) Is not engaged in planning or in implementing a plan for awater resource inventory area under the terms of chapter 90.82 RCW; and (c) Is composed entirely of cities and watersewer districtsauthorized to exercise the power of eminent domain in the mannerprovided by chapter 8.12 RCW.
